english.note: Use this when obliging someone means helping them or doing them a favour.
Use this when the sense is lending a hand, especially with a particular task or activity.

examples.english: I came over to help you move on moving day—I was happy to oblige.
examples.traditional: 你搬屋嗰日，我過嚟幫手，唔使客氣。
examples.jyutping: nei5 bun1 uk1 go2 jat6 ngo5 gwo3 lai4 bong1 sau2 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3

examples.english: Thanks for coming to assist on moving day.
examples.traditional: 搬屋嗰日，多謝你嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping: bun1 uk1 go2 jat6 do1 ze6 nei5 lai4 bong1 sau2
